name: Source-grounded temporal assessments
scope: Targeted fresh primary-source review of all 12 open-left records, plus six temporal spot checks. Other records preserve canonical values and are explicitly marked as not individually researched in this pass.

policy.date_convention: ISO calendar days in UTC; lower bounds inclusive and upper bounds exclusive. A day-wide bound does not imply a midnight event.
policy.exact_times: Only preserve or assign a clock time when it dates that particular source event. Source-estimated milliseconds remain estimates.
policy.context_bounds: Narrative bounds are analyst inferences, not exact dates, event duration, probability distributions or evidence of causal order.
policy.open_bounds: Null remains unknown. No artificial lower bound is assigned from the first dated corpus event, a different model run or a document publication date.
policy.publication_dates: Publication can bound completion of a reported retrospective action; it cannot be substituted for that action date.
policy.undated_display: Keep open-left training precursors in a clearly separate undated region. Do not put them at July 13, July 14, April 20, May 7 or June 11. No finite display_context_window is supplied for them.
policy.relative_order: Atomized steps retain their source episode grouping, but this review does not invent inter-event timestamps or causal edges.
policy.application: Merge the six temporal fields by event_id for display and query. Preserve assessment_status, source_evidence and rationale for inspection. Do not mutate the canonical dataset.
